wahl.description: Up to version 0.25 this integration was internally called “eta_webservices”. Your existing setup can be taken over with all settings, entities and history.

uebernahme.title: Take over setup
uebernahme.description:
Taking over: {anlagen}.

Settings, entities with their IDs, history, device and ash box plan are kept. Afterwards the old setup and the old folder custom_components/eta_webservices are removed.

puffer.title: Buffer tank volume
puffer.description: The 'Puffer' function block shows its effective volume on the controller display but does not pass it on to the webservices. Enter how many litres your buffer tank holds - for example the 'Effektives Puffervolumen' value from the display, the type plate or the documentation. The integration uses it to work out how much heat is stored in the buffer, and the pellet forecast becomes more accurate. 0 means: unknown.

raumfuehler.title: Room sensor from Home Assistant
raumfuehler.description:
These heating circuits are set up with 'Raumfühler ext. Schnittstelle' (room sensor via external interface). Pick a thermometer from Home Assistant for each circuit - the integration writes its temperature to the system every 30 seconds as the room temperature. Without a selection the system gets no room value.

The **time monitoring** is a setting of the system: if no new value arrives for that long, it discards the old one and reports 'Raumfühler: Keine Verbindung'. It is 1 minute by default - the system then reports this on every Home Assistant restart. 10 minutes bridge a restart. It is only written if you change the value.

reconfigure.description: For example when the heating system got a new address on your home network. Components, permissions and all other settings are changed under **Configure**.

switch_warning.title: Switching writes to your heating system
switch_warning.description:
You enabled switches. From now on Home Assistant can not only read your heating system, but also switch the boiler and the heating circuits off and on.

Please be aware:
- Switching off a heating circuit or the boiler in winter can let rooms cool down. Frost protection remains the responsibility of the heating system, not of Home Assistant.
- Anyone with access to your Home Assistant can operate these switches.
- Switches only appear where your heating system explicitly reports the variable as writable.

You can turn this off again at any time under Configure.

zeitplaene.title: Heating schedule from Home Assistant
zeitplaene.description:
Pick a **schedule helper** for each heating circuit (Settings → Devices & services → Helpers → Schedule). Each of its blocks becomes a time window of the heating system; outside the blocks the setback applies. Whenever the schedule changes, and on start-up, the integration writes the changed time windows to the system. Changes made on the display last until then.

The heating system currently has:

{programm}

Best draw the schedule exactly like this, then nothing changes when you switch it on. If it differs, the integration asks under **Settings → Repairs** before it writes anything for the first time.

The system has **at most 3 time windows per day** and works in quarter hours. A temperature is only written if a block carries one in its additional data (`temperature: 21`) - otherwise the temperatures of the heating system stay as they are. Without a selection the schedule stays untouched.

verbindungen.title: Who is connected to what
verbindungen.description: The webservices do not tell which part of the system feeds which. Pick the source for each part - this is what the lines in the **ETA Overview** card follow. The preset: the boiler charges the first buffer tank, further buffer tanks follow one after another, heating circuits and hot water hang on the last one. Buffer tanks and the transfer line both receive heat and pass it on.

component_not_found.title: Component "{component}" not found
component_not_found.description:
The menu of your ETA heating system contains no values for the component "{component}". Its function block is probably named differently on your controller (expected roles: {fub_names}).

Open **Settings -> Devices & Services -> ETA Web-Services -> Configure** and enter the actual name, or untick the component if your system does not have it.

raumfuehler_stumm.title: Thermometer {raumfuehler} has been silent for {stunden} hours
raumfuehler_stumm.description:
The thermometer {raumfuehler} is the room sensor of {heizkreis}, but it has not sent anything for {stunden} hours - not even the same value again. Is its battery empty?

The integration keeps writing the last value to the heating system, so the heating circuit is controlled with an old room temperature. As soon as the thermometer reports again, this notice disappears by itself. If it is gone for good, choose another one under **Settings -> Devices & services -> ETA Web-Services -> Configure**.

zeitplan_zu_voll.title: Schedule {zeitplan} does not fit on every day
zeitplan_zu_voll.description:
The heating system has at most 3 time windows per day. The schedule {zeitplan} for {heizkreis} has more blocks on these days: {tage}.

The integration does not transfer these days; the system keeps its own schedule there. Merge the blocks in the schedule and this notice disappears by itself.

confirm.title: Transfer schedule {zeitplan}

abort.zeitplan_nicht_aktiv: The schedule is no longer selected or the integration is not running right now.
